name: anomia1
label: Next to health, money is most important

questions.text:
Now I'm going to read you several more statements. Some people agree with a statement, others disagree. As I read each one, tell me whether you more or less agree with it, or more or less disagree.
A. Next to health, money is the most important thing in life.

name: selfirst
label: Take care of yourself first before others

questions.text:
As I read each of the following statements, please tell me whether you strongly agree, agree, neither agree or disagree, disagree, or strongly disagree with it. 
A. You have to take care of yourself first, and if you have any energy left over, then help other people.
